finalText:
React re-renders a child whenever the parent re-renders, unless the child is wrapped in `React.memo`. Same props isn't enough on its own.

Two common traps even with `memo`:

- If a prop is a function or object made fresh each render (like `onClick={() => ...}`), it looks "new" every time. Wrap it in `useCallback` or `useMemo` so it stays the same.
- Passing `children` as JSX also creates a new object each render.

So: add `React.memo` around the child, and make sure any function or object props are memoized too.
